rule: Owner decision 2026-10-22: "All universities should include all faculty that work on CS-related topics / publish in CS venues (Even if not in CS)." Candidates: hierarchy/<school>/cs-related-candidates.json (tools/cs_related_candidates.py: OpenAlex authors with 8+ school works 2016-2026, 5+ and 20%+ of them DBLP-indexed, last author on 30%+ or 30+ works, not already a PI). A candidate is accepted when (1) faculty at the school in some year 2016-2026 in any department (professor ranks incl. adjunct/titular and emeriti; EPFL MER/Senior Scientist heading a group; not postdocs, research staff, lecturers without PhD direction, visitors/host professors or students), (2) a PI: first-listed thesis director / named adviser of a 2016-2026 doctoral thesis record, or a lab they head alone, and (3) appointment years come from dated faculty lists (emeritus entries are not appointment years); a reviewed period is added to hierarchy/census-overrides.json when the appointment does not cover 2016-2026.
tools: hierarchy/cs-related-tools/pe_index.py, pe_epfl.py, pe_merge.py, pecap.py (+ epfl_listtext.py for faculty-list entries)
sources: Faculty lists: listings/epfl/captures.sqlite and hierarchy/cs-related-captures-epfl.sqlite (school, institute and EPFL-wide lists 2016-2026, the EDEE thesis-director list); Infoscience doctoral thesis records (hierarchy/epfl/thesis-captures.sqlite); live people.epfl.ch profiles.
